content.text:
`createLabels` in `lib/labels.js` now requests labels one at a time. Each request waits for the previous one to finish. The shipments still come back in their original order. All 30 existing tests pass.

I didn't add a test for the one-at-a-time behaviour, so nothing in the suite checks it.

If one label request fails, the rest are no longer sent. `createLabels` still throws the same "The carrier gave no label for order …" error. Before, with `Promise.all`, every request had already gone out by the time one failed. The labels that did succeed before the failure are not returned.
